desc.zh: 将低区间的禁用票号映射到高区间的可用值，推导等概率抽取。
desc.en: Repair blocked tickets with unused high values and derive uniform picking.

complexity: Expected O(b + 1) initialization time and space; expected O(1) time per pick, one random API call

concepts.name: Uniform blacklist remapping
concepts.description: Pair blocked low tickets with distinct legal high values to preserve equal probability.

concepts.name: Random API calls and rejection sampling
concepts.description: Compare materialization, unbiased retries and one-call remapping.
